description: This file contains utility functions for mapping and normalizing graph data, including color coding based on progress status, and functions to convert backend payloads into a normalized graph structure for visualization. It also includes a mock graph generator.

methods.name: mapGraphPayload
methods.description: Converts backend/legacy graph data into a normalized format with nodes and links, applying color coding based on progress and gap status.

methods.name: getMockGraph
methods.description: Provides a small mock graph with predefined nodes and links for testing or fallback rendering.
